name: H7-09
description: H7-09, nicknamed Aychseven, was a droid who was a member of the Nihil marauder organization. The droid served in the Tempest of Tempest Runner Lourna Dee, operating aboard her starship, the Lourna Dee.

data.name: H7-09
death: By c. 250 BBY, Tycoon Trader, Abrion sector (rebuilt)
